subject: Workflows deleted by a teammate
customer_question: Someone on my team deleted 12 workflows. I want them back NOW and I want to talk to a real person.
resolution: You were very frustrated, and understandably so, as 12 workflows were accidentally deleted by a teammate. We escalated your issue to technical support, who restored the workflows from version history within 2 hours. They also explained the role permissions to help prevent this from happening again in the future. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
